purpose.content: getCurrentReading returns the newest valid value for one known sensor without exposing history mutation or acting as a generic data schema.

fields.boundary: The operation is the public query boundary; validation, buffering, and controller orchestration remain internal or external respectively.
fields.participants: Controller invokes the operation and Aster export adapter executes it read-only.

operation.content: The request contains only sensorId; success returns the current Reading and does not accept time ranges, writes, or arbitrary buffer indices.

fields.operations: getCurrentReading(sensorId) returns Reading, NOT_READY, UNKNOWN_SENSOR, or TIMEOUT and has no retry or mutation side effect.
fields.data_shapes: Request is {sensorId: string}; Reading is {sensorId, utcTimestamp, celsius, quality?} with finite numeric celsius.

errors.content: Unknown identifiers return UNKNOWN_SENSOR before buffer access, empty history returns NOT_READY, and timeout returns no value or fallback timestamp.

fields.error_behavior: UNKNOWN_SENSOR, NOT_READY, and TIMEOUT are terminal outcomes; none creates, updates, or backdates a Reading.
fields.invariants: At most one terminal outcome per request, no history mutation, and success always returns the newest valid value at read time.

compatibility.content: Version 1 returns three required fields; version 2 may add optional quality while preserving request shape, operation name, and all error meanings.

fields.version_policy: Major changes alter required fields or outcomes; optional response fields and additive documentation are minor compatible changes.
fields.compatibility_policy: Old callers may ignore quality and new callers must accept its absence; UNKNOWN_SENSOR and NOT_READY never change meaning.

trace.content: The operation traces to Example::InteractionFlow and planned success, unknown, empty, timeout, and compatibility checks.

fields.model_elements: Example::InteractionFlow defines the fictional request/validation/response order exercised by the operation.
fields.verification_links: Success, unknown, empty, timeout, no-mutation, and version 1/2 response checks are planned verification cases.
